cases.name: Mary Susan "Susie" Pryor Montag
cases.about: "A Jacksonville realtor who her friend Heidi Turner described as “crazy busy,” Montag would stay up late at night to finish the administrative side of her job, saving the daylight hours to take picnics with her friends, sit in her co-workers’ offices to check on their well-being, and calm even the most troublesome of clients."
cases.narrative:
"On Oct. 26 Charles Henry Harper Jr., Montag’s ex-boyfriend, rammed Montag’s parked car outside Dunkin Donuts on Western Boulevard and fired several shots at her before fleeing, The Daily News reported. The Jacksonville Police Department executed a search warrant at 915 Vernon Drive, Harper’s last known residence, and found Harper inside dead of an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound. One of the bullets hit Montag’s face, Turner said, fracturing her sinus cavity. One of the blood vessels surrounding her sinus cavity weakened, creating an aneurysm. Turner said the aneurysm was just recently found, and it ruptured soon after." 

https://www.jdnews.com/news/20190424/jacksonville-realtor-brought-joy-to-those-around-her
